   11: ## 1. The 5-Step REGULATOR-MONODROMY-AXIS-DECOMPOSITION Methodology
   12: 
   13: When investigating regulator-class monodromy on spectral-action moments, follow this sequence (workshop §E-2 R2-B):
   14: 
   15: ### Step 1 — Enumerate regulator-class boundaries
   16: 
   17: Enumerate the regulator-class boundaries in the regulator atlas. Each boundary corresponds to a sign convention or class selector that the regulator picks up when crossed. The W-12 calibration enumerated TWO boundaries:

   21: 
   22: ### Step 2 — Classify each boundary as LOCAL or GLOBAL (Wodzicki-residue locality argument)
   23: 
   24: Classify each boundary using the Wodzicki-residue locality argument:
   25: 
   26: - **LOCAL** — UV / heat-kernel-coefficient sign. LOCAL boundary acts on a_k coefficients pointwise in heat-kernel expansion. The Wodzicki-residue / a_4 contribution is a LOCAL invariant of D_K, computed from bulk metric and gauge data.
   27: - **GLOBAL** — IR / asymptotic-completion topology. GLOBAL boundary acts on asymptotic-completion data (e.g., choice of ℐ⁺ class, asymptotic conformal-end selector).

   29: W-12 calibration:
   30: - Axis-M (Mellin local-residue) → LOCAL
